description_en: Queries the tags that are bound to resources
description_zh: 当您需要查询资源标签时，可调用ListTagResources接口，查询资源已经绑定的标签列表
kebab_example: aliyun privatelink list-tag-resources --resource-type vpcendpoint --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTagResources

parameters.help_en: The list of resource IDs. You can specify up to 50 resource IDs
parameters.help_zh: 资源ID列表。最多支持50个资源ID
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en:
The resource type. Valid values:

vpcendpoint: endpoint.                                

vpcendpointservice: endpoint service
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型。取值：

vpcendpoint：终端节点。                                

vpcendpointservice：终端节点服务
parameters.name: resource_type

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag keys. If you specify this parameter, the value cannot be an empty string.

The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length. It must start with a letter or Chinese character and can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:` and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签键。最多支持20个标签键。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。

最多支持64个字符，必须以字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-），不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag values. If you specify this parameter, the value can be an empty string.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter or Chinese character and can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:` and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签值。最多支持20个标签值。一旦传入该值，可以为空字符串。

最多支持128个字符，必须以字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-），不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure that the value is unique among different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the resource. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120468.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh: 资源所属的地域ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120468.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether a next query token is available. Valid values:

If this is the first query or no next query is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

If a next query is available, set the value to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：

第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。

如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

NextToken.description_en:
Specifies whether a next query token is available. Valid values:

If this is the first query or no next query is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

If a next query is available, set the value to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：

第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。

如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
